name: Grill With Docs
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.
longDescription: A two-line composition: it invokes `/grilling` (the interview primitive — rounds of questions, facts are the agent's job, decisions are yours) and `/domain-modeling` (sharpen fuzzy terms, record hard-to-reverse decisions as ADRs) together. That makes it the **stateful** interview: what it learns lands in `CONTEXT.md` and ADRs in the working directory, where `/to-spec`, `/triage` and `/improve-codebase-architecture` later read it. `/grill-me` is the stateless twin for work with no repo. Both sibling skills must be installed; assumes `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` ran once per repo.
